fixture_name: Four-lane arterial improvement — US preliminary design (FHWA case study, PD)
subject: judge-baseline

justifications.substance: Vehicle interference among queued, turning, and parking movements at closely-spaced intersections is a substantive preliminary-design safety issue on a corridor with recorded accident history.
justifications.evidence_grounding: The pivotal claim is directly supported by the verbatim EV-US-016 quote matching the statement text, with location corroborated by the recorded TABLE A.1 Issue 3 reference.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly framed as a safety_concern within FHWA RSA preliminary-design scope, with no compliance/safety category confusion and no normative basis asserted.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Recommendation is specific and viable—turning-movement restriction plus relocating identified stalls clear of the functional area—though it leaves exact movements to later design detail.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians and cyclists are explicitly acknowledged as potentially present but scoped out as not central to the vehicle-interference mechanism, consistent with the acknowledge-if-not-applicable convention.

justifications.substance: Queue spillback between signals only ~650 ft apart is a well-recognized safety mechanism (intersection blocking, sudden stops, rear-end risk) and checking queue storage/coordination is squarely substantive at preliminary design.
justifications.evidence_grounding: The pivotal claim (650 ft spacing to the Dirksen Parkway/Clear Lake Avenue signals) is supported by a verbatim quoted passage under EV-US-001, exceeding registry-id-only citation; the spillback inference is transparently labelled as derived rather than asserted as recorded fact.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Framed purely as a safety_concern with a safety-oriented check/recommendation, with no compliance requirement conflated into it, consistent with FHWA RSA preliminary-design semantics.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Recommendation names concrete, viable preliminary-design actions (signal coordination, Do Not Block Intersection signing, enhanced conspicuity of displays/signing) rather than a null or generic directive.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians and cyclists crossing at both signalized intersections are explicitly acknowledged and the scoping to vehicle occupants is reasoned from the identified mechanism, constituting genuine consideration of VRU relevance.
